name: Trouble Witch's!!
source:
An inexperienced magician has mistakenly sent our hero and Orihime to the dream world. They want to go back to the real world as soon as possible, but it looks like it will take more than a month just to prepare for the ceremony to send them back. Until then, they have to stay with Pastel, the inexperienced magician, who brought them here in the first place. 

This is an orthodox AVG with very cute characters. You will get to meet the following exciting characters: Orihime, Pastel, Milfiyu, Princess Acerola, Chocola, and Maroon. The disagreeable Cacao will also appear, as he tries to capture Orihime. We hope you will enjoy this really fun story!

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20030225223703/http://gamelexgs.com:80/gameinfo/2001/ta/trouble/]Gamelex[/url]]
translation:
一位缺乏经验的魔法师错误地将我们的英雄和织姬送到了梦想世界。他们想要尽快回到现实世界，但看起来光是准备送他们回去的仪式就需要一个多月的时间。在那之前，他们必须留在帕斯特尔身边，这个没有经验的魔术师首先把他们带到了这里。

这是一款正统AVG，人物非常可爱。你将遇到以下令人兴奋的角色：Orihime、Pastel、Milfiyu、Princess Acerola、Chocola和Maroon。令人讨厌的可可也会出现，他试图抓住织姬。我们希望你会喜欢这个非常有趣的故事！

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20030225223703/http://gamelexgs.com:80/gameinfo/2001/ta/trouble/]游戏乐士[/url]]
